title: LSD May Speed Up Brain Activity and Make it Fractal - Nautilus
gist: Nautilus covers a new study suggesting LSD speeds up and makes brain activity fractal, a more complex reshuffling than the older view that psychedelics simply turn down control networks such as the default mode network.

insights.claim: Since at least 2012 scientists have believed LSD and psilocybin alter experience by reducing activity in control centers such as the default mode network, which supports self-reflection, autobiographical memory and ego.
